items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a locally of finite type morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S, the image of the finite type points of X is contained in the finite type points of Y (source lines 5091-5097). The proof represents a finite type point x by a locally finite type morphism Spec(k) -> X and observes that the composite with f is again locally of finite type by permanence of local finite typeness under composition, which is exactly the definition of f(x) being a finite type point.
